req.title: Deleting all tasks leaves empty table
req.statement: The system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task has been deleted.
triggers: deleting all tasks leaves empty table

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-035 requires that after every task is deleted, GET /tasks/ returns an empty list []. We need: (1) a positive test that creates multiple tasks, deletes each one, and asserts GET /tasks/ == []; (2) a negative test that attempts to delete a non-existent task and asserts HTTP 404; (3) a boundary test covering the single-task edge case (exactly one task created then deleted, leaving []). Each test uses an in-memory SQLite DB via override of get_db, ensuring isolation. Assertions are exact-value to kill mutations on status codes, response bodies, and list lengths.

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r035_pos.db"
engine = create_engine(SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list():
    titles = ["Task Alpha", "Task Beta", "Task Gamma"]
    ids = []
    for t in titles:
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": t, "completed": False})
        assert r.status_code == 201
        ids.append(r.json()["id"])
    assert len(ids) == 3
    for task_id in ids:
        r = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
        assert r.status_code == 204
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == []

test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list()

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r035_stc.db"
engine = create_engine(SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_tasks_one_by_one_state_transitions():
    rA = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task A", "completed": False})
    assert rA.status_code == 201
    id_a = rA.json()["id"]
    rB = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task B", "completed": True})
    assert rB.status_code == 201
    id_b = rB.json()["id"]
    d1 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{id_a}")
    assert d1.status_code == 204
    g1 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert g1.status_code == 200
    g1_body = g1.json()
    assert len(g1_body) == 1
    assert g1_body[0]["id"] == id_b
    assert g1_body[0]["title"] == "Task B"
    d2 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{id_b}")
    assert d2.status_code == 204
    g2 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert g2.status_code == 200
    assert g2.json() == []
